title: Learned cluster expansion guides an acidic oxygen-evolution catalyst
summary: A fitted energy model and quantum-inspired optimizer selected a mixed-oxide catalyst family for laboratory testing. The study reports a Ru-Cr-Mn-Sb oxide catalyst with higher ruthenium-normalized activity than its RuO2 comparator and sustained operation in the tested setup. This is one bounded materials result, not commercial electrolyzer validation or evidence that the optimizer itself is a learned model. The catalyst result already appears in the May 2022 preprint.
ai_technology: DFT-trained cluster expansion with quantum-inspired search
organization: University of Toronto; Harvard University; Fujitsu Consulting (Canada)

evidence.tested: Selected oxide catalysts received electrochemical activity and stability measurements.
evidence.unknown: Scale-up, independent replication and general design success rates were not established.
evidence.ai_role: DFT-trained cluster expansion with quantum-inspired search supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary v1 preprint abstract/history; indexed publisher article and institutional publisher-PDF passages on model fitting and affiliations; supplements not reviewed.
